The '''Anzaada Cavern''' was a cavern within [[Mount Anzaada]], a mountain on the border of the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] and [[Kaamos Territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The cavern was filled with ancient ruins, and was the only way of reaching the summit of the mountain. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive occupied the cavern.
